description: This file contains a test suite that verifies handling of special event names in an EventEmitter implementation. It imports testing functions from '@playwright/test' and a custom EventEmitter, then runs tests to ensure event names like '__defineGetter__', 'toString', and '__proto__' are supported and correctly handled.
